The '''Leafar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Greater Plooriod sector/Legends|Greater Plooriod sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It held the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Leafar (planet)|Leafar]], home to the [[Leafar]] organization.<ref name="X-wing" />
